title: 番台ディストリクト
subtitle: 架空オープンワールド 予告
style: Third-person open-world game cutscene look, live-action cinematic photorealism, shallow depth of field, steady game-camera motion, no anime, no illustration

world.name: Shirayu district
world.lock: Fictional old downtown district around the public bathhouse Shirayu: narrow shopping street with tiled shop fronts, potted plants, utility poles and wires, warm street lamps, and a brick boiler alley with a tall brick chimney behind the bathhouse

aki.lock: 28-year-old Japanese woman, short black bob, white cotton tenugui towel tied over her hair with a dark patterned hem, plain indigo cotton happi jacket over a dark shirt, dark work pants, rubber sandals, calm determined face, natural makeup

yoshida.name_ja: 理容ヨシダ 店主 吉田
yoshida.lock: Japanese man in his early 60s, neat grey side-parted hair, white mandarin-collar barber jacket with a small round crest on the chest, warm anxious face

gen.lock: stocky Japanese man in his late 50s, slicked-back grey hair, thick eyebrows, gold happi jacket with black trim over a black t-shirt, gold chain necklace, smug grin

props.tenugui: white cotton hand towels, folded in a neat stack
props.bicycle: black city bicycle with a front wire basket
props.truck: small white Japanese kei pickup truck with split cedar firewood stacked in the bed

borrowed: mission subtitle grammar with the object noun in colour
a mundane errand that flips into action

cards.kicker: 舞台・人物・物語はオリジナル

オマージュは三人称カメラとミッション字幕の見せ方だけ

beats.place: Bathhouse entrance opening onto the sunny shopping street, morning
beats.camera: Over-the-shoulder third-person camera behind Aki at shoulder height, following her out of the doorway with a slight walking bob
beats.action: Aki pushes through the blue wave-pattern noren of the bathhouse holding a folded stack of white towels, steps onto the sunny shopping street, glances right, and breaks into a jog down the street
beats.sfx: Noren cloth brushing, rubber sandals slapping on stone, a distant bicycle bell, quiet morning street ambience
beats.music: Low pulsing synth bass with a single taiko hit at the start; holds under the whole clip

hud.mission: 貸し手ぬぐいを理容室へ返せ

beats.camera: Third-person chase camera behind and slightly above the bicycle, tracking forward smoothly
beats.action: Aki rides the black city bicycle down the shopping street with the towel stack in the front basket, pedals faster, leans into a gentle turn; shop curtains and potted plants slide past
beats.sfx: Bicycle chain whir, tires on asphalt, a shop radio far away, wind
beats.music: Low pulsing synth bass, a little faster; a rhythmic hi-hat joins

hud.mission: 貸し手ぬぐいを理容室へ返せ

beats.place: Inside a small old barbershop with a leather chair, mirrors, and lace curtains
beats.camera: Static medium two-shot at eye level, a very slow push-in
beats.action: Aki hands the folded white towels to Yoshida across the barber chair; he takes them with both hands and nods, relieved; Aki gives a small bow

speech.line: てぬぐい、おかえししますね

beats.sfx: Quiet barbershop, a wall clock ticking, cloth rustle
beats.music: Soft warm pad, the bass rests

hud.mission: 貸し手ぬぐいを理容室へ返せ

beats.place: Inside the barbershop, warm window light
beats.camera: Over Aki's shoulder onto Yoshida's face, slow push-in, shallow depth of field
beats.action: Yoshida wrings his hands and talks fast, pointing toward the back alley; Aki, seen from behind, listens, then squares her shoulders

speech.line: まきが ぜんぶ もっていかれた

beats.sfx: Quiet barbershop, a wall clock ticking, a chair creak
beats.music: Soft warm pad with a low ominous tone creeping in

hud.mission: 理容室の店主を落ち着かせろ

beats.place: Narrow wet alley with vending machines at dusk
beats.camera: Third-person camera behind Aki at the open driver door, holding as the truck pulls away
beats.action: Aki climbs into the white kei truck and shuts the door; the headlights flick on and the truck pulls away down the wet alley with the firewood swaying in the bed
beats.sfx: Truck door thunk, small engine starting, tires on wet asphalt, vending machine hum
beats.music: Bass returns with a driving taiko pattern

beats.place: Shopping street at dusk, headlights on
beats.camera: Low third-person chase camera ahead of the speeding kei truck, swinging around behind it
beats.action: The kei truck barrels down the shopping street; adults in shop aprons and a bicycle tumble harmlessly through the air like ragdolls, cabbages and a plastic crate scatter, a vending machine tips over; Aki grips the wheel with a small grin
beats.sfx: Engine revving, horn, crates clattering, cabbages thumping, comedic whoosh as bodies fly
beats.music: Driving taiko and synth bass, rising

beats.place: Brick boiler alley at night, wet ground, pipes, chimney
beats.camera: Low dramatic angle holding on Aki, then a whip tilt upward following Gen
beats.action: Aki plants her feet on the iron grate and launches a rising uppercut; a column of white steam erupts under her fist and hurls Gen straight up, arms flailing, sandals flying, and he tumbles out of the top of the frame

speech.line: まき、かえしてもらうよ

beats.sfx: Steam blast roar, a heavy comedic whoosh, sandals slapping the ground later
beats.music: Taiko hits stop for a beat, then a big brass stab on the uppercut

beats.place: Boiler alley at night, the boiler house behind
beats.camera: Wide shot, camera retreating ahead of Aki as she sprints toward it
beats.action: Behind her the brick boiler house erupts in an orange fireball and a white steam pillar; roof tiles and logs fly; the white kei truck tumbles end over end silhouetted against the blast; Aki sprints toward camera lit orange and does not look back
beats.sfx: Deep explosion boom, steam roar, debris pattering on tiles, her fast footsteps
beats.music: Full taiko and bass hit on the blast, then a rising synth swell

beats.place: Boiler alley, steam thinning, chimney standing
beats.camera: Third-person camera behind Aki, slow push-in on her back
beats.action: Aki stands still and catches her breath as steam vents from the wrecked boiler alley; she turns a valve on a pipe, the steam thins, and she tucks the white towel back over her hair
beats.sfx: Hissing steam fading, a valve squeak, water dripping, her breathing slowing
beats.music: The beat drops out; a single warm koto note rings and fades
